title: GenXR-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive XR Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.29014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are rapidly advancing from single-file generation to long-horizon repository-scale engineering, yet the evaluation of their capabilities to author interactive extended reality (XR) applications remains an open challenge. Unlike traditional software, XR applications operate within dynamic 3D physical environments where runtime robustness depends jointly on continuous user motion, spatial input, and environmental sensing. We introduce GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark for the end-to-end evaluation of coding agents in XR software development. GenXR-Bench contains 112 expert-authored tasks spanning 24 feature implementations, 21 bug repairs, and 67 application generation tasks. Held-out tests combine scripted and adaptive interactions with programmatic and visual assertions to evaluate core functionality and runtime behavior. translated_title: GenXR-Bench：面向交互式XR开发的编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 编码智能体正迅速从单文件生成发展为长时程的仓库级工程，但对其编写交互式扩展现实（XR）应用能力的评估仍然是一个开放性挑战。与传统软件不同，XR应用运行于动态的3D物理环境中，其运行时鲁棒性同时取决于持续的用户动作、空间输入和环境感知。我们提出了GenXR-Bench，这是首个用于编码智能体在XR软件开发中进行端到端评估的基准。GenXR-Bench包含112个由专家编写的任务，涵盖24个功能实现、21个漏洞修复和67个应用生成任务。保留测试集结合了脚本化与自适应交互，以及程序化断言和视觉断言，以评估核心功能和运行时行为。针对124个候选应用的盲测专家判断，GenXR-Bench的测试套件达到了96.5%的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个用于端到端评估编码智能体XR软件开发能力的基准GenXR-Bench，通过112个专家编写任务以及结合脚本化/自适应交互与程序化/视觉断言的测试方式，有效评估核心功能和运行时行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark for end-to-end evaluation of coding agents in XR software development, featuring 112 expert-authored tasks with scripted and adaptive interactions combined with programmatic and visual assertions to assess core functionality and runtime behavior.
